kinyarwanda: Mukoresha amazi menshi kurusha uko bisanzwe

kinyarwanda: Fagitire yanyu iheruka yagaragaje amazi aruta ayo musanzwe mukoresha ho hafi {percent}%

kinyarwanda: Ni ikigereranyo gishingiye ku gipimo mwanditse. Si fagitire, kandi icyo gipimo ntikibikwa.

english: Your last reading was only a few days ago, so this estimate still uses your usual use.
kinyarwanda: Igipimo giheruka kimaze iminsi mike gusa cyoherejwe, bityo iki kigereranyo kiracyashingira ku mazi musanzwe mukoresha.

kinyarwanda: Kuva ku gipimo giheruka, mwakoresheje amazi menshi cyane kurusha uko bisanzwe

kinyarwanda: Andika igipimo kiri kuri mubazi ubu. Ntikibikwa kandi ntigikoreshwa mu gukora fagitire.

english: This number is lower than your last reading. Check the digits.
kinyarwanda: Iki gipimo kiri munsi y'igipimo giheruka. Genzura imibare.

english: Your number is kept. Try again.
kinyarwanda: Igipimo mwanditse kirabitswe. Ongera ugerageze.

english: We could not confirm this reading. Your new reading is being checked.
kinyarwanda: Ntitwashoboye kwemeza iki gipimo. Igipimo gishya mwohereje kirimo kugenzurwa.

english: We could not confirm this reading. Your new reading was accepted.
kinyarwanda: Ntitwashoboye kwemeza iki gipimo. Igipimo gishya mwohereje cyemejwe.

english: What Mubazi collects about your household, why it is used, and how to raise a concern. This student prototype uses demo households.
kinyarwanda: Amakuru Mubazi ikusanya ku rugo rwanyu, icyo akoreshwa n'uko mwatanga ikibazo muyafiteho. Uyu mushinga w'igerageza w'umunyeshuri ukoresha ingo z'impimbano.
Amakuru abikwa

english: Your name, phone number, household address or sector, meter details and water account details.
kinyarwanda: Amazina yanyu, nimero ya telefoni, aderesi y'urugo cyangwa umurenge, amakuru ya mubazi n'aya konti y'amazi.

english: The readings you submit, AI-suggested digits and confidence, staff review decisions, bills, payment records and messages.
kinyarwanda: Ibipimo mwohereza, imibare yatanzwe n'ubwenge buhangano n'icyizere buyifitiye, ibyemezo by'abakozi bagenzuye ibipimo, fagitire, inyandiko z'ubwishyu n'ubutumwa.

english: Meter photos you send and, if you allow location access, your phone location when you take a photo.
kinyarwanda: Amafoto ya mubazi mwohereza n'aho telefoni yanyu yari iri igihe mwafotoraga, niba mwarabyemeye.
Abashobora kubona ayo makuru

english: A household signed in with its phone number can access the accounts linked to that number. Signed-in staff can access household records for review, billing and support; supervisors and administrators have additional correction and account-management permissions. Staff can view meter photos during reading review. Project operators with server or database access can also access stored information. Household records are not a public directory.
kinyarwanda: Urugo rwinjiye rukoresheje nimero yarwo ya telefoni rushobora kubona konti zose zihuza n'iyo nimero. Abakozi binjiye bashobora kubona amakuru y'ingo kugira ngo bagenzure ibipimo, bakore fagitire kandi batange ubufasha. Abagenzuzi n'abayobozi ba sisitemu bafite n'uburenganzira bwo gukosora amakuru no gucunga konti. Abakozi bashobora kureba amafoto ya mubazi igihe bagenzura ibipimo. Abashinzwe umushinga bafite uburenganzira kuri seriveri cyangwa ku bubiko bw'amakuru na bo bashobora kubona amakuru abitswe. Amakuru y'ingo ntaboneka ku bantu bose.
Igihe amafoto abikwa

english: The default photo retention period is 90 days, configurable by the operator. Unconfirmed photos become eligible for deletion after one day. Cleanup runs on uploads and scheduled cleanup while the API is awake, so deletion may happen later. Removing a photo does not delete the associated reading, bill or review record.
kinyarwanda: Ubusanzwe amafoto abikwa iminsi 90, ariko ushinzwe sisitemu ashobora guhindura icyo gihe. Amafoto ataremejwe ashobora gusibwa nyuma y'umunsi umwe. Gusiba bikorwa iyo hari ifoto nshya yoherejwe no mu bihe byateganyijwe igihe seriveri ikora, bityo bishobora gutinda. Gusiba ifoto ntibisiba igipimo, fagitire cyangwa inyandiko y'igenzura bijyanye na yo.

english: Why we ask where you are
kinyarwanda: Impamvu dusaba kumenya aho muri

english: Only to see whether the photo was taken at your meter. If not, an officer looks at the reading. Your reading is never refused because of this alone.
kinyarwanda: Ni ukugira ngo tumenye gusa niba ifoto yafatiwe kuri mubazi yanyu. Iyo bitamejwe, umukozi agenzura igipimo. Igipimo cyanyu nticyangwa kubera iyo mpamvu yonyine.
Gukosora amakuru no gutanga ibibazo ku ibanga ryayo

english: For this prototype, use the project issue tracker below to request a correction or raise a privacy concern. Describe the problem without personal details and ask the maintainer how to share details privately. Do not post phone numbers, meter photos, account details or sign-in codes publicly. Staff can review household details and readings; bill and meter corrections require the appropriate staff permissions.
kinyarwanda: Kuri uyu mushinga w'igerageza, koresha urubuga rwo gutanga ibibazo rw'umushinga ruri ku murongo uri hasi kugira ngo musabe gukosora amakuru cyangwa mutange ikibazo ku ibanga ryayo. Sobanura ikibazo utashyizemo amakuru bwite, maze ubaze ushinzwe umushinga uko wayamuha mu ibanga. Ntugashyire nimero za telefoni, amafoto ya mubazi, amakuru ya konti cyangwa kode zo kwinjira ahagaragara. Abakozi bashobora kugenzura amakuru y'ingo n'ibipimo. Gukosora fagitire n'amakuru ya mubazi bisaba uburenganzira bwabigenewe.
Vugana n'ushinzwe umushinga wa Mubazi

english: AI-generated readings are suggestions and can be wrong, including when a photo is blurred, poorly lit or shows digits between positions. Confidence scores do not guarantee accuracy. Check the digits against your meter and correct them before submitting. You can type a reading when AI is unavailable. Unusual readings may be held for staff review; an AI suggestion is not a verified reading or a final billing decision.
kinyarwanda: Ibipimo bitangwa n'ubwenge buhangano (AI) ni ibyifuzo kandi bishobora kuba bitari byo, cyane cyane iyo ifoto itagaragara neza, urumuri rudahagije cyangwa imibare ya mubazi iri hagati y'imyanya ibiri. Amanota y'icyizere ntahamya ko imibare ari yo. Gereranya iyo mibare n'iri kuri mubazi yanyu, maze mukosore ibitari byo mbere yo kohereza. Mushobora kwandika igipimo ubwanyu igihe ubwenge buhangano butaboneka. Ibipimo bidasanzwe bishobora kubanza kugenzurwa n'umukozi. Igipimo cyatanzwe n'ubwenge buhangano ntikiba kiragenzurwa kandi si icyemezo cya nyuma cya fagitire.
Ibipimo by'ubwenge buhangano bikeneye kugenzurwa namwe

english: The prototype uses Vercel for the website, Render for the API and Neon for the database. Household information and photo-location evidence are stored on the server and in the database. Your browser stores a sign-in session and preferences; sign out on shared devices.
kinyarwanda: Uyu mushinga w'igerageza ukoresha Vercel ku rubuga, Render kuri API na Neon ku bubiko bw'amakuru. Amakuru y'ingo n'ay'aho ifoto yafatiwe abikwa kuri seriveri no mu bubiko bw'amakuru. Mushakisha yanyu ibika amakuru atuma mukomeza kuba mwinjiye n'amahitamo yanyu. Musohoke muri konti igihe mukoresha igikoresho musangiye n'abandi.
Aho amakuru abikwa

english: Phone numbers identify linked accounts and support sign-in codes and notifications. Meter details, photos and readings help calculate water use and bills, check unusual readings and resolve corrections. Payment records track bill balances. Messages keep you informed about your account.
kinyarwanda: Nimero za telefoni zifasha kumenya konti zihuye na zo no kohereza kode zo kwinjira n'ubutumwa. Amakuru ya mubazi, amafoto n'ibipimo bifasha kubara amazi yakoreshejwe na fagitire, kugenzura ibipimo bidasanzwe no gukosora amakuru. Inyandiko z'ubwishyu zifasha gukurikirana amafaranga asigaye kuri fagitire. Ubutumwa bubagezaho amakuru ya konti yanyu.

english: This reading is below the last one. Accepting makes it the meter's new starting point and bills only the service charge, so check for a replaced meter or a wrong earlier reading first. Rejecting asks the household for a new photo.
kinyarwanda: Iki gipimo kiri munsi y'igipimo giheruka. Kucyemeza bigihindura igipimo gishya cyo gutangiriraho cya mubazi, kandi fagitire ikabamo amafaranga ya serivisi gusa. Banza ugenzure niba mubazi yarasimbuwe cyangwa igipimo cyabanje cyaranditswe nabi. Kucyanga bisaba urugo kohereza indi foto.
